summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for client-level HTTP mocking using requests_mock. It differs semantically from peer VCR (record/replay at network layer) and filesystem mocking (different domain). Existing skills are unrelated (Spring routing, URL fetch with timeout). No merge, split, or revision applies. Support evidence is minimal but not conflicting. Skill is well-defined, actionable, and fills a legitimate test isolation capability gap.
